subject: AWS Marketplace: offer funnel copy + co-sell hooks
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@cloudrev.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudrev.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace: offer funnel copy + co-sell hooks

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Team liked the latency/cost story and the dedicated capacity option. Before we publish the offer page, our GTM and procurement folks asked for two things we need your help with:

1) A short hero blurb (1–2 lines) that calls out the primary customer outcome for our SMB data analytics persona. This will be used on the listing and in co-sell decks.

2) A clear trial entitlement matrix: which SKU/trial length maps to what capacity (GPU hours, concurrency) and any restrictions (data residency, private deployment). Procurement also wants the standard procurement phrasing for the private offer flow.

Can you and your team share a first-pass by EOD Monday? If easier, templates or a few alternate hero lines would work — we can choose.

Attaching our draft buyer one-pager for context (not attached here because of size).

Best,
Emma
Emma Park
Head of Partnerships, CloudRev Solutions
ema: emma@cloudrev.com | m: +1 415 555 0218

Thanks Emma — looping in Kim, Jonas, and Olga to get the right copy + entitlement mapping. Drafts attached: hero_blurb_v1.docx and trial_matrix.csv.

Quick notes / ask for reviewers:
- Kim: please prioritize the hero lines and the two short co-sell callouts (for the seller-facing tile and the co-sell enablement slide). We want one optimistic line + one pragmatic line for procurement.
- Jonas: double-check the language around trial capacity. CloudRev asked for GPU-hours per trial SKU; confirm the wording won’t create false expectations when we turn on Dedicated.
- Olga: any AMI/legal guardrails (govcloud/private offer phrasing) we need to add?

Goal: get a consolidated copy and a single-trial-matrix CSV back to Emma by Monday 12/21 so they can finish their marketplace intake.

Marissa
Sr. Growth PM, Redwood Inference

Marissa — quick pass below. I kept options short so CloudRev can pick the tone that matches their seller story. Also added a tiny copilot snippet (copilot-snippet.md) for the Marketplace assistant preview.

Hero options (pick 1):
- "Deploy production-grade LLM inference for analytics teams — predictable latency, lower token cost, and easy private deployments."
- "Fast, cost-efficient LLM inference tailored for data teams — reserved throughput and enterprise controls out of the box."

Co-sell callouts (tile / slide):
- "Redwood + CloudRev: enterprise inference with predictable costs and rapid time-to-value."
- "Secure private deployment options for regulated workloads (SLA-backed Dedicated pools)."

Procurement-friendly line (short):
- "Private offers supported; contact sales for contractual SLAs, regional deployment, and metering terms."

Tiny copilot assistant preview (one line):
- "Ask me about trial quotas and regional support for your account — quick summary and setup link."

I also looked at the trial matrix and suggested labeling for SKU names to avoid ambiguity (attached to my reply). Jonas — tagging you to confirm GPU-hour math.

—Kim
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: copilot-snippet.md (md)

Subject: AWS Marketplace: offer funnel copy + co-sell hooks

Emma — thanks for the patience. Consolidated below and attached the final files for the Marketplace intake. Let us know which hero line you prefer and we’ll finalize the tile copy.

Consolidated hero (we recommend the top line for marketing and the pragmatic line for procurement):
- Recommendation (marketing): "Deploy production-grade LLM inference for analytics teams — predictable latency, lower token cost, and easy private deployments."
- Procurement-safe (short): "Private offers supported; contact sales for contractual SLAs, regional deployment, and metering terms."

Co-sell slide snippets (short):
- "Redwood + CloudRev: enterprise inference with predictable costs and rapid time-to-value."
- "SLA-backed Dedicated pools and private deployment options for regulated workloads."

Trial entitlement summary (high level):
- Trial SKU: "trial-basic" — 72-hour trial, 50 GPU-hours, single-region (us-west-2), no private deployment.
- Trial SKU: "trial-pro" — 14-day trial, 400 GPU-hours, multi-region preview, private deployment requires signed PO and AMI verification.

Attachments included: hero_blurb_v1.docx, trial_matrix.csv, copilot-snippet.md.

Next steps:
- Emma: pick the hero line and confirm trial-pro private deployment requirement language for procurement.
- Jonas: can you confirm the GPU-hour caps by EOD Tuesday (12/22)? If Dedicated capacity is needed earlier we’ll flag that in the intake.

If no changes, we’ll upload the listing assets to the AWS Seller Console on Wednesday and send the co-sell deck assets to your Partnerships folder.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Growth PM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | Ext. 7421
